risks.title: Economic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: The vehicle sales industry is sensitive to economic conditions, including unemployment, consumer confidence, fuel prices, interest rates, and tariffs. Tariffs announced in 2025 could increase costs and reduce demand.

risks.title: Import Tariffs
risks.score_rationale: Tariffs announced by the U.S. government on imported vehicles and parts could increase costs, limit inventory availability, and reduce demand, with a material impact on operations.

risks.title: Manufacturer Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on vehicle manufacturers for its supply of new vehicles and for warranty and maintenance services.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks, particularly due to its reliance on third-party vendors for its information systems. The 2024 CDK outage demonstrated the potential impact.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, with numerous players present in the automotive retail sector.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to government regulations, including those related to environmental protection and road safety.

risks.title: Interest Rates
risks.score_rationale: Interest rates can impact vehicle sales and company results by affecting the financial affordability of vehicles for consumers.

risks.title: Fuel Prices
risks.score_rationale: Fuel prices can impact vehicle sales, particularly gasoline-powered vehicles.

ai_positioning.summary: AutoNation has no significant mentions regarding artificial intelligence in the 10-K. Its business focuses on vehicle sales and related services (parts, maintenance, insurance, and financing).
